analysis.title: GS Trade Idea - Short Consumer Staples (GSXUSTAP)
key_insights: GS FICC & Equities (Louis Miller) likes shorting its Diversified Staples Basket (GSXUSTAP), published 6 Nov 2026.
The desk says the basket's earnings yield and dividend yield are unattractive relative to fixed income (treasuries, credit) and growth in the group does not justify the valuations.
Earnings revisions have been rolling over, and the basket's P/E is in the 90th percentile relative to the last year.
The valuation premium of S&P Staples to SPX is at the highest level in 10+ years.
GSXUSTAP dividend yield of 2.84% is 2.05pp below its 10-year average and at the 1st percentile of the last 10 years.

GSXUSTAP has outperformed SPX by nearly 20% in the last month and is up about 1% more than SPX over the last year. Staples had their best month in 5+ years and YTD performance is second best in 10 years.
Historically staples have lagged SPX over the 3 months following similar events, with the exception of late 2021/early 2022.
The desk prefers a delta one (basket swap) implementation because, with rates where they are, the short earns carry on the swap, while puts look rich and put skew is near the lows.

sector_views.rationale: Short the GS Diversified Staples Basket on stretched valuation versus SPX and fixed income, falling earnings revisions, and a sharp 1-month outperformance that has historically mean-reverted over the next 3 months.

earnings_insights: Earnings have lagged the latest price action in staples, and earnings revision breadth is rolling over at the same time (desk charts, as of 6 Nov 2026). No company-level EPS or revenue figures given.

trade_ideas.description: Short GS Diversified Staples Basket (GSXUSTAP), delta one implementation (swap)
trade_ideas.rationale: Valuation is stretched versus SPX and fixed income, revisions are rolling over, and the 1-month outperformance has historically been followed by 3-month relative underperformance.
trade_ideas.risk: Max loss on delta one implementations is unlimited, per the disclosure.

risk_factors: Delta one short has unlimited maximum loss.
Momentum risk: staples have just had their best month in 5+ years, and the one historical exception to 3-month lag was late 2021/early 2022.
Backtested and past performance results are illustrative and not a reliable indicator of future results.
vol_and_positioning: Puts on the staples basket look rich and put skew is near the lows, so the desk prefers a delta one short over buying puts.
With rates where they are, the delta one short gets paid on the swap (positive carry on the short).
